titre: Consult the tool catalogue before creating a tool; keep it up to date; generalise the tools into a universal toolbox
regle: Before writing a tool: search the tool catalogue (and chercher_outil) for a tool that already does the job, and extend it (new version, tests, adoption) rather than writing a parallel one. A project script that is useful beyond the task is generalised (parameters instead of hard-coded paths, standard header, negative tests) and then promoted into outils/ by preparer/adopter, and the catalogue is regenerated. Tools are called by their shortcut (outils/<outil>.py), never by the versioned file. Goal: a toolbox that covers every situation already met and fixed, so as to decide correctly when facing new ones.
source: The user's message of 2026-10-16: "it is important that you consult the catalogue before creating new tools, and also keep this catalogue well up to date and generalise your tools well so as to have a toolbox of tools universal to any situation you have previously encountered and fixed".
preuve: Session of 2026-10-16: porte_livraison written although livrer and evaluer_travail exist; verifier_noms written although detecter_noms works through its shortcut (wrongly called by its versioned file); scripts of 17_comparaison not promoted.
application: Skills cadre-travail-deterministe and orchestration-agents-recursive (Step 0); tools chercher_outil, catalogue, organiser_outils.
controle: Every new tool carries in its header "CATALOGUE CONSULTÉ : <neighbouring tools examined>"; the catalogue is regenerated after each adoption.
